purpose: Current-year canonical evidence shard for LORE Crypto History. Facts may be verified while long-term historical significance remains provisional.

events.title: Ethereum's second Fusaka BPO fork raises blob capacity again
events.summary: The second Blob Parameter Only fork following Fusaka activated on 7 January 2026, raising Ethereum's per-block blob target to 14 and maximum to 21.
events.significance: It extended Fusaka's PeerDAS scaling plan by increasing rollup data capacity without waiting for another full network upgrade.

events.title: SEC and CFTC issue joint crypto-asset legal interpretation
events.summary: The SEC issued an interpretation clarifying how federal securities laws apply to certain crypto assets and transactions, with the CFTC joining to state it would administer the Commodity Exchange Act consistently with the interpretation.
events.significance: The joint action was a major attempt by the two principal US market regulators to provide a common federal framework for classifying and treating crypto activity.

sources.title: SEC — Clarifies Application of Federal Securities Laws to Crypto Assets

events.title: CFTC approves a listed Bitcoin perpetual contract on a US regulated exchange
events.summary: The CFTC approved KalshiEX's BTCPERP, a perpetual futures contract referencing the spot price of Bitcoin.
events.significance: The approval brought a crypto-native perpetual-contract structure into a CFTC-regulated US exchange framework.

sources.title: CFTC — Approves BTCPERP Contract Submitted by KalshiEX

events.title: CFTC issues guidance for 24/7 trading and clearing
events.summary: CFTC staff issued an advisory addressing regulatory expectations for 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement, noting crypto derivatives as a market that may be particularly suited to continuous trading.
events.significance: The advisory reflected traditional regulated market infrastructure adapting toward the always-on model established by crypto markets.

sources.title: CFTC — Advisory on 24/7 Trading, Clearing, and Settlement

events.title: BitMEX closes after eleven years of exchange operations
events.summary: BitMEX announced on 23 July that it would wind down following a strategic review, and all exchange trading ceased at 04:00 UTC on 23 September 2026.
events.significance: The closure ended the exchange most closely associated with popularizing the crypto perpetual swap and 100x leverage during the industry's early derivatives era.

events.title: SEC proposes Regulation Crypto Assets
events.summary: The SEC proposed Regulation Crypto Assets, a tailored securities-offering regime for certain investment contracts involving crypto assets, including new registration exemptions and a conditional safe harbor.
events.significance: If adopted, the proposal could materially reshape how some crypto-related offerings access US capital markets; as of September 2026 it remains a proposal, not a final rule.
events.notes: Do not describe proposed provisions as final law.
